title: 5 Person Team Builds $300k AI Model Matching Fable 5
summary:
The creators of Ultramarine 1 Flash have launched an open-source tool for knowledge work that is 60x cheaper than competing frontier models. A team of 5 post-trained the model for approximately $300,000, enabling it to achieve performance similar to Fable 5. The model is currently accessible via API, and the developers will release the weights in two weeks.

The release targets a professional user base, including bankers and lawyers, as part of a push for training efficiency. This entry comes at a time when Chinese laboratories dominate the open-source landscape, accounting for more than 80% of all open-model usage on the OpenRouter platform.
